'''Fixer 66''' was the codename of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who held the rank of [[Fixer (Imperial Intelligence)|Fixer]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], he monitored [[Balmorran resistance|resistance]] communications in the [[Markaran Plains]], and developed a plan to booby-trap comm devices so that they would explode at the resistance's bases when salvaged from corpses. He recruited the technical expert known as [[Toybox]] to carry out the plan.<ref name="Mission" />
